text: Yes, the 2023 tree-cover loss on this property is confirmed. Earth observation data from Hansen GFC and JRC GFC2020 supports the claim of tree-cover loss within the asset in 2023. About 4.5 hectares of tree cover were lost, corroborated by observations from a later year and the JRC 2020 reference map. The loss occurred in a planted forest context, primarily affecting Pinus elliottii and Pinus taeda plantations.
